item.description: Import the updated companies.thailand.json before this demo. Run the original setup and registration steps, then this folder in order; alternatively set userAEmail and password to an existing account. Location requests require OpenCage access. For Runner, use a 1200 ms request delay. Inspect searchLocation for the resolved address, coordinates and effective radius. The current default radius is 5 km. Demo locations include Bangkok districts, Hua Hin, Pak Kret and Hat Yai; seed coordinates represent district or municipality centres.

request.description: Run the original registration steps first, or set userAEmail and password to an existing account. This request stores extraDemoToken for this folder.

request.description: Search around Pathum Wan, Bangkok, Thailand. Inspect searchLocation to see the resolved coordinates and radius. Demo company coordinates represent the district or municipality centre.

exec: pm.test("Successful company list", () => { pm.expect(res.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(res.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(res.count).to.eql(res.data.length); pm.expect(res.count).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test("Search location and radius are returned", () => { pm.expect(res.searchLocation.formattedAddress).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(res.searchLocation.latitude).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(res.searchLocation.longitude).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(res.searchLocation.radiusKm).to.eql(5); });
